physical.summary:
A backstrap tension loom(a); includes back beam with foot rest; breast beam with completed natural cream tabby baste fibre cloth; reed; lease sticks; headles; wooden upright; long red tabby cotton cloth with polychrome embroidered panels tied to upright; large cylindrical bamboo "drum".

Accomanying objects:  One large wooden treadle(b); one shuttle with cover(c); one bamboo stick(d); one wide leather strap(e); one rope (dessicated) (f).
